title: Mailbox full
symptom: Warning that the mailbox is full and email cannot be sent or received
user_description: I've got a message saying my mailbox is full. I'm not getting new emails and I can't send any.

options.text: Delete all her emails without checking
options.why: Risky and may remove important records. Never delete a user's mail without their agreement.

options.text: Create a new email account for her
options.why: Splits her mail across two places and does not fix the cause. It creates more work later.

options.text: Help her clear space by archiving or deleting large and old emails and emptying Deleted Items, following company retention rules
options.why: Large attachments and old mail use the most space, and emptying Deleted Items frees more. Following retention rules makes sure nothing that must be kept is removed.

options.text: Tell her to ignore the warning
options.why: Ignoring it means she will stop receiving mail, which can cost business.

hints: What takes up the most space in a mailbox?
Who decides which emails can be deleted?
real_world_tip: Sort by size in Outlook to find the big attachments first. A few large emails often free most of the space.
